request.prompt: An editorial cover illustration of a single fern frond, finely engraved cocoa-brown linework with small brass-gold accents on light cream paper. Use the library image only for its cocoa and brass palette. No lighthouse, no icon-style rounded object, no words, no border. One landscape image with the whole fern visible.

checks.detail: One connected frond; stem base, terminal tip and leaflets are visible.
The specimen spans the landscape diagonally without clipping.
Fine brown contours and hatching with small brass-gold vein accents on light cream paper.
No lighthouse, architecture, rounded icon composition or sculpted rendering.
No visible words, border, watermark or extra objects.
Cream paper fills the canvas; inspection confirmed no transparency.

live.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: editorial cover illustration, one landscape image, 16:9.
Scene/backdrop: opaque light cream paper with a quiet, subtle natural paper grain.
Subject: exactly one complete fern frond, from the bare base of its stem to its delicate terminal tip. Fine branching veins and many finely divided leaflets, with clear spacing and a graceful natural curve.
Style/medium: finely engraved botanical illustration in cocoa-brown ink; delicate controlled linework and fine hatching, with small restrained brass-gold accents integrated into a few veins and leaflet details. Flat printed artwork with exquisite engraved detail.
Composition/framing: a single large, legible specimen arranged on a gentle diagonal across the landscape page. The entire fern is visible, all leaflets and both ends comfortably inside the canvas, surrounded by clean cream breathing room. Calm editorial composition, no reserved title block.
Input image: Image 1 is ONLY a palette reference. REQUIRED: borrow its warm cocoa-brown and aged brass-gold hues, using cocoa for the engraved lines and brass for small accents. Do not borrow its subject, composition, background, materials, lighting or rendering style. This is a new botanical illustration.
Constraints: no lighthouse, architecture, rounded icon-style object, 3D rendering, sculpted volume, dramatic shadows, extra fronds, detached leaves, extra objects, decorative ornaments or border. No words, lettering, labels, numbers, signature, watermark or palette swatches. Keep the background light cream and opaque.

referenceUse.traits: Warm cocoa brown and brass gold only.

observations: Small gold accents along veins complement the brown engraving without dominating it.
Diagonal placement keeps the whole specimen visible in the landscape composition.
